title: RECOMBINANT MICROORGANISM COMPRISING CALVIN CYCLE AND METHOD USING THE SAME
abstract: The present invention relates to recombinant microorganisms transfected with Calvin cycle genes and a method using the same and, more specifically, to recombinant vectors containing genes coding the Calvin-Benson-Bassham cycle (cbb) of a Calvin cycle originated from Rhodobacter sphaeroides; recombinant microorganisms transfected with the recombinant vectors; a method for reducing carbon dioxide using the recombinant microorganisms; or a method for producing effective organic matter. The recombinant microorganisms transfected with the Calvin cycle genes are capable of not only reducing carbon dioxide due to an ability to fix carbon dioxide obtained by the introduction of the Calvin cycle genes, but also providing a method for increasing the production of effective organic matter due to an increase in photosynthetic efficiency, thereby being able to grow faster than existing microalgae, solve biological environmental issues using the recombinant microorganisms having a markedly excellent effect on the reduction of carbon dioxide, and increase the production of high value matter through the carbon dioxide fixation.
